correctness.rationale: After unitary frequency dilation, K_t=tT_t* T_t. Absolute Hilbert--Schmidt analyticity of the bounded-window exponential kernel justifies the Cauchy--Binet exterior-power expansion; its unique lowest total degree r(r-1)/2 is the Vandermonde rank-one operator with norm c_r=(2π)^(r(r-1)/2) product_{j<r} sqrt(h_j(E)h_j(F))/j!. Ratios of consecutive exterior singular norms prove the exact fixed-index limit; convergence of one-dimensional exterior singular vectors and nested projections proves each orthogonal-polynomial eigenmode. Strict moment-Gram positivity and eventual singular-value separation hold for any positive-measure window. Exact moment arithmetic and disconnected-window quadrature verify n=0,1,2 constants and eigenmode overlaps, without being substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The original two-domain localization problem supplies the precise operator and the missing mode-resolved question. The result gives a nontrivial hierarchy at every fixed index with exact constants depending on all moments through degree 2n and identifies asymptotic concentrating eigenmodes on arbitrary measurable, possibly disconnected and asymmetric spatial and spectral windows. This resolves small-bandwidth high-order spectral behavior beyond eigenvalue counting and beyond a principal-only expansion, providing testable calibration for irregular aperture/spectral designs. Generality, nontrivial eigenfunction limits and non-subsumption motivate the statement; finite checks are supporting only.
